episodeTitle.en: A framework for finding product-market fit | Todd Jackson (First Round Capital)
episodeTitle.zh: 《寻找产品-市场匹配的框架》 | 托德·杰克逊（First Round Capital）

guestBioOfficial.en: Todd Jackson is a Partner at First Round Capital. Before moving into venture capital, he played a crucial role as VP of Product and Design at Dropbox, guiding the company until its IPO in 2018. Prior to Dropbox, Todd led product management for Twitter’s Content and Discovery teams after selling his startup, Cover, to Twitter in 2014. Before Cover, Todd oversaw product development for Facebook’s Newsfeed, Photos, and Groups. He kickstarted his career at Google as an associate product manager and eventually led product for Gmail, witnessing its growth from beta to 200 million users. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why product-market fit (PMF) matters
guestBioOfficial.zh: 托德·杰克逊（Todd Jackson）是First Round Capital的合伙人。在投身风险投资之前，他曾在Dropbox担任VP of Product和Design，助力公司于2018年成功上市。在Dropbox之前，托德于2014年将自己的初创公司Cover出售给Twitter后，领导Twitter的内容与发现团队的产品管理工作。在Cover之前，托德曾负责Facebook Newsfeed、Photos和Groups的产品开发。他在谷歌的职业生涯始于助理产品经理，最终负责Gmail的产品管理，见证了该产品从测试版到2亿用户的成长历程。在我们的对话中，我们将探讨：•产品-市场匹配（PMF）为何至关重要

title.en: A framework for finding product-market fit | Todd Jackson (First Round Capital)
title.zh: 《寻找产品-市场匹配的框架》 | 托德·杰克逊（First Round Capital）

summary.en: Todd shares how a product leader thinks as a VC, including what he looks for in founders and teams, and how his operating background shapes his investments. He discusses lessons from building Gmail, the Facebook News Feed redesign, and Dropbox, plus why he believes more operators should move into venture. The episode is a unique blend of product craft and investing wisdom.
summary.zh: Todd 分享了一位产品领导者作为投资人是如何思考的，包括他在创始人与团队身上寻找什么，以及他的运营背景如何塑造其投资。他讨论了打造 Gmail、Facebook 动态消息改版与 Dropbox 的经验，以及为什么他认为更多运营者应当进入风投。本期是产品手艺与投资智慧的独特融合。
